payload.question: Did the council actually make the savings it said it would?
payload.label: Savings delivered against target, 2024/25
payload.council_caveat: The council recognised the risk itself: it holds a budget risk reserve, then £1.8m, "to provide resilience against emerging pressures and delays in the delivery of savings".
payload.evidence: The 2025/26 budget report records that the previous year's budget "includes £3.1 million of savings and income proposals for delivery in 2024-25". No published report we have found says how much was delivered. The same commitment is tracked on this site as a promise, in the council's own words and with its own date; this card is the money side of it, and both are grey for the same reason.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
